mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'FINISHED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS finished, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'EXPIRED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS expired, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'CANCELLED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cancelled, ROUND( SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'FINISHED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN status IN ('FINISHED','EXPIRED') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) , 3) AS fulfillRate, ROUND(SUM(TIME_TO_SEC(TIMEDIFF(end_time, start_time))) / 3600, 1) AS bookedHours FROM seat_booking WHERE book_date BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to}

SELECT b.seat_id AS id, s.seat_no AS name, r.name AS extra, COUNT(*) AS times, 0 AS noShow, ROUND(SUM(TIME_TO_SEC(TIMEDIFF(b.end_time, b.start_time))) / 3600, 1) AS hours FROM seat_booking b JOIN lib_seat s ON s.id = b.seat_id JOIN lib_room r ON r.id = b.room_id WHERE b.book_date BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to} AND b.status IN ('BOOKED','CHECKED_IN','LEAVING','FINISHED') GROUP BY b.seat_id, s.seat_no, r.name ORDER BY hours DESC, times DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT v.user_id AS id, u.nickname AS name, u.username AS extra, COUNT(*) AS times, SUM(CASE WHEN v.type = 'NO_SHOW' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS noShow, 0 AS hours FROM violation v JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = v.user_id WHERE v.created_at >= #{from} AND v.created_at < DATE_ADD(#{to}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) GROUP BY v.user_id, u.nickname, u.username ORDER BY times DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT HOUR(start_time) AS id, CONCAT(HOUR(start_time), ':00') AS name, '' AS extra, COUNT(*) AS times, 0 AS noShow, 0 AS hours FROM seat_booking WHERE book_date BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to} AND status IN ('BOOKED','CHECKED_IN','LEAVING','FINISHED') GROUP BY HOUR(start_time) ORDER BY id
